caveats: Region contains 3600 grid cells (lat 63.32-64.50 N, lon 21.32-22.50 E on the 0.02 deg grid); 3299 sea cells (finite SST on all 92 target days) were analysed, 301 land cells excluded and set to 0. All 4028 baseline-window files (1991-12-27 to 2003-01-05) and 92 target files (2009-06-01 to 2009-08-31) were present and read successfully. Land cells are NaN on every day and sea cells finite on every day, so no threshold pool contained NaN values. Threshold = 90th percentile (numpy method='hazen', Hyndman-Fan type 5) of the +/-5 calendar-day pool per day of year from baseline years 1992-2002 (windows extend 1991-12-27 to 1991-12-31 and 2003-01-01 to 2003-01-05); climatology = pool mean; day of year 60 set to mean of days 59 and 61; both smoothed with an unweighted centred 31-day moving mean wrapping the 366-day year. Per-cell MHW: run of >=5 consecutive days with SST (kelvin) >= threshold, with gaps of 1-2 non-hot days joined. Regional events: days with >=1 sea cell inside a per-cell MHW; two events detected: 2009-06-24 to 2009-07-04 and 2009-08-04 to 2009-08-14.
